description: This bar chart illustrates the values of γ (gamma) across five categories labeled 0 through 4, displayed along the horizontal axis in ascending numerical order. The vertical axis is labeled “γB” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals.  Each category is represented by a single, vertically striped bar colored in shades of purple and pink. The bar corresponding to category 0 reaches approximately 0.62, while the bar for category 4 reaches approximately 0.32. The heights of the bars generally decrease from left to right, with the bar for category 1 at approximately 0.58, category 2 at approximately 0.54, and category 3 at approximately 0.50. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
